Synthetic reference vectors generated by scripts/generate-conformance.ts.
Sources: FFmpeg lavfi testsrc2 and gradients (no external photographs).
.heic: one intra HEVC picture in a minimal HEIF container.
.yuv: planar YUV reference decoded from the matching HEVC stream (FFmpeg or the official HM reference software, as noted below); 8-bit bytes or LE16 samples.
Each vector is checked sample-by-sample before RGB conversion.

Nokia's `heif_conformance` files are copyrighted and are not included here.
The pinned C044 `pred`-reference differential check downloads its source file
in memory and compares decoded planes to an FFmpeg 9.0.1 checksum; run
`bun run validate:nokia-pred`. See `docs/VALIDATION.md` for the sample hash,
reference conditions and supported scope.

ipred-b-nokia-3.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 Main Still Picture vector
`IPRED_B_Nokia_3` (29,168 bytes, SHA-256
`456608ae5c14fea0496d770ae9614cd3d7c6ae98c14b22d64bbd96b37f49d7a0`). It
contains one 1920x1080 I picture and exercises all 245 luma/chroma intra
prediction mode and block-size combinations. The test wraps it as a synthetic
`heic` HEIF item and checks the reconstructed planes against the archive YUV
MD5 `ec3bcad4f9174404e52d132206b6617b`.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/HEVC_v1/IPRED_B_Nokia_3.zip

adjust-ipred-angle-a-mitsubishi-2.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 Range
Extensions `ADJUST_IPRED_ANGLE_A_RExt_Mitsubishi_2` vector, Main 4:2:2 10,
1920x1080, 10-bit, three I pictures. It exercises all chroma intra prediction
modes at the C16x32, C8x16 and C4x8 block sizes. The bitstream MD5 is
`acdc40dcc3dbc0c5574ca3a6fc721394`; SHA-256 is
`54b72f9b2f5bd7c25049a63fd4289ab19735af5b30c2105dedd7aa5ae90a72e8`. The
regression checks each picture's embedded Y/Cb/Cr decoded-picture hashes and
the complete display-order YUV MD5 `b045776950c2e06d35348bd03268c07f`. Each
picture is wrapped as a synthetic `heix` HEIF item; the wrapper is not an
official container vector.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/RExt/ADJUST_IPRED_ANGLE_A_RExt_Mitsubishi_2.zip

ccp-8bit-rext-qcom-1.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 `CCP_8bit_RExt_QCOM_1`
cross-component prediction vector (1280x720, 8-bit 4:4:4; one I and eight B
pictures). The bitstream MD5 is `89ff7b4e90585587eda35d596dacc172`; SHA-256 is
`c5e0d9b5e0062c2f4bfb1ec9e8a6465fb715e3af498306d7d0e4bec0bc9bae5c`. The
regression checks all pictures against the archive display-order YUV MD5
`54231c6f121ca65d8b94a747b9504b8b` and checks the final picture through a

Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/RExt/CCP_8bit_RExt_QCOM_1.zip

hevc-12bit-444-qp74.hevc and hevc-12bit-444-qp75.hevc: synthetic 128x64
12-bit 4:4:4 streams from FFmpeg PR #25467, generated with x265 4.2. They cover
the maximum QP indices 74 and 75 for 12-bit HEVC. The regression compares both
raw decoding and synthetic `heix` HEIF items against the encoder-reconstruction
MD5 values `dd156676d75cc4801291a3a4d52ab375` and
`28f5c39656c53f3dc6c147200e7223f2`. Source, reconstructed YUV, and generation
details:
https://github.com/ohah/FFmpeg/tree/df6c311a005073ab714089c5a7b727098e30bb1d/repro/hevc-qp74-75

mvresidc-b-ms-2.bit: the complete 9-picture, 1280x720 8-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `MVRESIDC_B_MS_2` integer-MV vector (SHA-256
`c7e21066c689bf0ccb80b60cb03663862777a45f0e68d40ed4e8fcf81287cf9e`). The

mvresidc-a-ms-2.bit: the complete 9-picture, 1280x720 8-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `MVRESIDC_A_MS_2` vector with
`motion_vector_resolution_control_idc` equal to 0 (SHA-256

mvresidc-c-ms-3.bit: the complete 9-picture, 1280x720 8-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `MVRESIDC_C_MS_3` vector (SHA-256
`cba0360cfacea5b9e3f859ab82700e5793cfb7344ed935e4c8c159c47cf8fa31`). It
signals `motion_vector_resolution_control_idc = 2`; its even-POC B pictures

The regression checks the signalled mode and every picture's embedded
Y/Cb/Cr `decoded_picture_hash`. Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/SCC/MVRESIDC_C_MS_3.zip

ht-c-scc-apple-3.bit: the complete 3-picture, 1280x720 8-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `HT_C_SCC_Apple_3` vector (100,418 bytes, SHA-256
`b1b142921525da460c9df428ba7adba437f26c415e12a040e9de2ee348677cf0`). It
combines tiles and WPP; all three slices parse as P slices, and the first
picture uses the current picture as its reference. The archive's `.txt`
description calls the last two slices B slices, but both HM 16.16+SCM-8.6 and
the parsed slice headers identify them as P slices. The regression checks all
Y/Cb/Cr decoded-picture-hash values. Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/SCC/HT_C_SCC_Apple_3.zip

ht-a-scc-apple-2.bit: the complete 3-picture, 1920x1080 10-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `HT_A_SCC_Apple_2` vector (317,807 bytes, SHA-256
`1046c59afbba3092bea44d2f9aeec060762e776a79bdfeb93804e17a1d0d1c85`). It
combines tiles and WPP with CABAC bypass alignment and extended precision
disabled. The pictures are P/B/B at decode-order POCs 0, 2, 1. The regression
checks all Y/Cb/Cr decoded-picture-hash values. Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/under_test/HT_A_SCC_Apple_2.zip

ht-b-scc-apple-3.bit: the complete 3-picture, 1280x720 8-bit 4:4:4 official
SCC `HT_B_SCC_Apple_3` vector (100,839 bytes, SHA-256
`625df3b76a68ae86ced006a0122a041b230e5a2834ed163ecb20114e796923fc`). It
combines tiles and WPP with CABAC bypass alignment enabled and extended
precision disabled. All three parsed slices are P at POCs 0, 1, 2; the archive
`.txt` sidecar instead describes the last two as B. The regression checks all
Y/Cb/Cr decoded-picture-hash values. Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/under_test/HT_B_SCC_Apple_3.zip

dpb-loop-filters-a-mediatek-2.bit: the complete 10-picture, 1280x720 8-bit
4:4:4 official SCC `DPB_Loop_Filters_A_MediaTek_2` vector (SHA-256
`9287d1ee8bc21d13ddd4bc12fd07b8c77f77fa526518a76a11bdd8c593fd4cf1`). All
pictures enable current-picture reference. POC 7 disables both SAO and
deblocking and uses six active L0 references. The regression compares the

`8dba33e8843e05bca8eb8c0fb4131a6b`. It also compares POC 7 and POC 9 through

mini-C71.heic: Nokia's published HEIF conformance file
`content/conformance/C71.heic`, pinned at commit
`f01283f3e64ccc6e6ab489bd556d454879069185` (5,597 bytes,
SHA-256 `47601d59ee2d9a0ddc239b68f3e2a7d75c996ff6a2251edce003540bb04cabd9`).
It exercises the `mif3`/`mini` container with an 8-bit 4:2:0 HEVC image and
orientation 8. `mini-C71.yuv` is the 320x240 Y/Cb/Cr output from FFmpeg 9.0.1
after extracting the HEVC item and its parameter sets; it is a differential
reference, not a published ISO reconstruction checksum.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nokiatech/heif/f01283f3e64ccc6e6ab489bd556d454879069185/content/conformance/C71.heic

mini-alpha-L_8.{hvcc,hevc,y}: helper data for the synthesized `mini` alpha
integration test. The 128x128 8-bit monochrome HEVC item and its `hvcC` record
come from Pillow-Heif's pinned `L_8__128x128.heif` test file; `.y` is its
FFmpeg 9.0.1 decoded luma reference. Their sizes/SHA-256 are 106 bytes
`e37c6c5b59a7a279f782234493c88fe4f4c86b29c4d24be6ecf22496310c1c4c`, 2,210
bytes `11d4f826f646227acdaf3f5ae6c1260223c98ac24b930cea6833ab5426a2061b`,
and 16,384 bytes `83bf9379d5bcea5b8f54121ba820c82eab7f19ab8dbe3798a705beb0a55d8c11`.
The source file is 2,560 bytes, SHA-256
`d386c35ece16c8bdcf31fb5de150ecc596a94b23d5dd9057a71d0ddfe1261d71`. The test
combines this alpha item with the official C71 primary image to exercise the
low-overhead alpha fields. It is not an official mini-alpha conformance vector.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif/b16be1196dfa465a342d68894696e685ca3655cb/tests/images/heif/L_8__128x128.heif

chroma444-{8,10,12}: scripts/adversarial-reference.ts, HEIC_CHROMA=3, round 5,
seed=5*7919+depth, 256x128, CRF45/AQ2/WPP, default scaling lists, transform skip.
Planar 4:4:4 reference; 8-bit bytes or LE16 10/12-bit samples.
The 12-bit reference uses the QP74/75 table correction to FFmpeg 8.1.1
described in docs/VALIDATION.md. Unmodified FFmpeg produces incorrect chroma
for that case. A separately encoded x265 API reconstruction was also compared.

chroma422-8: scripts/generate-conformance.ts, 64x64 8-bit 4:2:2 HEVC image
item using the `heix` brand. ISO/IEC 23008-12 reserves `heic` for Main/Main
Still Picture; 4:2:2 Range Extensions use `heix`. Its
planar Y/Cb/Cr reference is decoded from the matching HEVC stream by FFmpeg;
the test compares every sample after deblocking and SAO.

confwin-a-sony-1.bit: the complete 60-picture 416x240 8-bit 4:2:0 ITU-T
H.265.1 `CONFWIN_A_Sony_1` conformance vector. Its SPS conformance window
crops one chroma sample from each edge, producing a 412x236 output while the
decoder processes the full 416x240 coded picture. The archive's complete YUV
MD5 is `a3ce3f936ff69ff1ec2621a622dd37ac`, reproduced with FFmpeg 9.0.1. The
focused regression wraps the POC 2 P picture as both an in-file and an
external one-tile `tili` item and checks its cropped planes against FFmpeg
9.0.1's display-frame-2 plane MD5s: Y `0dd05fb3395f7002bc3b389334639edd`, Cb
`f187dbd0639cfc59b43c09b89a1fd15e`, Cr
`74e3a2806dcb3931e18e48751a26882a`. The archive SHA-256 is
`c3c823ffb9e526f5d9506ba2f1239b1f0323572850789230d762f4e4678fc298`; the
bitstream is 283,483 bytes, SHA-256
`688c2684539ffdca60335e7da650da0236f76c20179c844a33395cceaebb1ca3`, MD5
`dce8104b2addbdd601eb280a88e18583`. Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/HEVC_v1/CONFWIN_A_Sony_1.zip

pcm-rext-422-10: the one-picture 416x240 IPCM_A_RExt_NEC_2 stream from the
official ITU-T RExt conformance archive, wrapped as a `heix` still-image item.
The stream is 10-bit 4:2:2 with 8-bit PCM samples and loop filters enabled.
The official bitstream MD5 is df77a372c0c2f7333beeccd787e5d32d; the reference
Y/Cb/Cr output from FFmpeg 9.0.1 matches the archive's official YUV MD5
8d4eb18812338f9f475035b8da27e74a. The test compares every sample after
deblocking.

pcm-rext-444-12: the one-picture 416x240 IPCM_B_RExt_NEC stream from the same
official archive. It is 12-bit 4:4:4 with 8-bit PCM samples and loop filters
enabled. Its official bitstream MD5 is 7d93d7bd66ebbd854a78f143edd8785c; the
FFmpeg 9.0.1 reference matches the official YUV MD5 eea32e6e1f88b7782515e53f8122be7d.
The test compares every sample after deblocking. Archives:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/RExt/IPCM_A_RExt_NEC_2.zip
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/RExt/IPCM_B_RExt_NEC.zip

slices-rovi3-i: the first 640x480 I picture (20 independent slices) from the
ITU-T H.265.1 SLICES_A_Rovi_3 stream, wrapped as a still-image item. The YUV
reference is the first picture from FFmpeg 9.0.1 output; FFmpeg's full
nine-picture output first matched the archive's published MD5. This focused
fixture does not claim decoding support for the vector's later inter pictures.

dependent-slices-hhi5-i: the first 1920x1080 I picture from the official ITU-T
H.265.1 DSLICE_A_HHI_5 stream (17 independent/dependent segments, WPP off).
dependent-slices-hhi5-wpp-i: the first I picture from DSLICE_B_HHI_5 (34
segments, WPP on). Both YUV references are FFmpeg-decoded first pictures;
their full-stream FFmpeg MD5s match the official archive checksums. Later
inter-coded pictures are outside these focused fixtures.

dependent-slices-hhi5-tiles-i: the first I picture from the official
DSLICE_C_HHI_5 vector (15 independent/dependent segments, 3x2 uniform tiles,
WPP off). Its YUV reference is the first picture from FFmpeg 9.0.1 output;
the full 50-picture output matches the official archive MD5. Later inter-coded
pictures are outside this focused fixture.

wpp-tiles-high-tp-8-i: the first I picture from the official
WPP_AND_TILE_HIGH_TP_444_8BIT_RExt_Apple_2 vector. It is 1024x768, 8-bit
YUV420, with two tile columns and WPP enabled. The focused HEIC fixture keeps

https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/RExt/WPP_AND_TILE_HIGH_TP_444_8BIT_RExt_Apple_2.zip
HM 16.14, from the official ITU-T H.265.2 reference
software package, decodes the complete three-picture stream to the archive's

reference has MD5 31ec266d850af20d08bd1c594bf9552c and is compared sample by

wpp-tiles-high-tp-10-422-i: the first I picture from the official

fixture keeps its first 1280x720, 8-bit 4:2:0 picture and the corresponding HM
16.15+SCM-8.4 Y/Cb/Cr output. It exercises palette predictor initialization in
an inter-coded picture. Its P slice enables current-picture reference, has no
external inter-picture motion, and reconstructs IBC-coded blocks. The extracted
picture fragment is 13,286 bytes (SHA-256

official bitstream file is SHA-256
`01c43d5a39084c770745d9cda812265015dc8fd38287a28365f3063dfe0d41e6`.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/AV-ARCH/JCTVC-Site/bitstream_exchange/under_test/PPI_B_InterDigital_2.zip

ppi-a-interdigital-2.bit: the complete 33-picture official ITU-T H.265.1
(10/2018) SCC `PPI_A_InterDigital_2` stream. The unit test extracts its POC 0,
16 and 32 random-access P-slices, which use SPS initialization, nonempty PPS
initialization and an explicitly empty PPS initializer, respectively. The
standalone `bun run validate:hevc-scc-ppi-a` command decodes all 3 P and 30
hierarchical B pictures and checks each against its embedded
`decoded_picture_hash` SEI. It also builds a synthetic 33-item HEIF `pred`
graph, with all three PPS records in `hvcC`, and verifies the primary POC 31
item through `decodeItemPlanes`. The complete source bitstream has MD5
`96f81d3ef08661724bf305edb08af177` and SHA-256
`27339fa9b5a70978ed0e3723ed80f18f014b313341825d4658a1fb492e89434b`. Source
archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/under_test/PPI_A_InterDigital_2.zip

act-ibc-qualcomm-first.{hevc,gbr}: the parameter sets and first P-picture from
the official ITU-T H.265.1 (10/2018) SCC `Slice_ACT_QP_Offsets_A_Qualcomm_2`
vector. This 1280x720, 8-bit 4:4:4 picture enables ACT and current-picture
reference; SPS palette mode is also enabled. The bitstream description says
the full two-picture stream uses HM-16.15+SCM-8.5; the official ITU H.265.2
package available for this check is HM-16.13+SCM-8.3. That reference decoder
passes the in-stream picture checksums, and its full `GBRtoRGB` output matches
the archive's published RGB MD5 `2d4ffc0354dee7216567c89dc1f20391`. The first
picture's raw GBR component planes (before output colour conversion) are
compared sample-by-sample. The
first-picture bitstream and reference SHA-256 values are
`8b785d52c109b03f30f2615f8f472c199f9a312e1d4fb73f9b1f763c38c019a6` and
`68a623c929fdcb4e997b4ee555454ab5a44870cf9091876ffacfd3773a8b36b6`.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/SCC/Slice_ACT_QP_Offsets_A_Qualcomm_2.zip

act-ibc-qualcomm-second-b.hevc: the second PPS, B-slice and its
`decoded_picture_hash` SEI extracted from the same official
`Slice_ACT_QP_Offsets_A_Qualcomm_2` stream. The 99-byte fragment has SHA-256
`2fbcc3de17bbb666f3a174ecfdb3364dfa9c4ae51795bfc822b2a52d92f08dc2`. It
selects PPS 1, enables slice ACT QP offsets, and signals POC 1 with the POC 0

external entry. The test combines this fragment with the pinned first-picture
fixture in a synthetic two-item HEIF `pred` graph and checks all three output
plane hashes against the embedded SEI. Source archive is the same as above.

explicit-rdpcm-a-bbc-1.bit: the complete 600-picture official ITU-T H.265.1
`ExplicitRdpcm_A_BBC_1` stream, listed in the conformance table under RDPCM

two-view vector (1024x768, 8-bit 4:2:0, 48 pictures). It enables inter-view
prediction in the non-base view and uses a random-access hierarchical-B
structure with IDR and CRA access units. Display-order YUV MD5 values are
`96c07ed86f99e2e4bd3a9ce990c7c488` (layer 0) and
`f8706d6ea10b9b68edfe9d9c699c70e2` (layer 1). The bitstream SHA-256 is
`b83890b9691a496d37dae27dea81fd0ede1905e2a757d46646ce257e105de630`.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/MV-HEVC/MVHEVCS_E_Qualcomm_3.zip

mvhevcs-f-qualcomm-3.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 `MVHEVCS_F_Qualcomm_3`
two-view vector (1024x768, 8-bit 4:2:0, 48 pictures). Inter-view prediction
is enabled only for the non-base view at IDR/CRA access units. Display-order
YUV MD5 values are `96c07ed86f99e2e4bd3a9ce990c7c488` (layer 0) and
`377275e59c2fbdaa28ca098f119943cc` (layer 1). The bitstream SHA-256 is
`6a09a8b5f2829d2d24fe13ce5ab5720154d3c8f2318cbf64bfd70ccae01b944a`.
Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/MV-HEVC/MVHEVCS_F_Qualcomm_3.zip

mvhevcs-g-ntt-3.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 `MVHEVCS_G_NTT_3` three-view
random-access PIP vector (1024x768, 8-bit 4:2:0, 49 pictures). The base view
is layer 0; layers 1 and 2 each directly depend on layer 0. Display-order YUV
MD5 values are `3bab3455424334d069ce5cce318872b2` (layer 0),
`ca16ff9a763c3af7bb9a5027a61319bc` (layer 1), and

Source archive:
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/MV-HEVC/MVHEVCS_G_NTT_3.zip

mvhevcs-i-nokia-3.bit: the official ITU-T H.265.1 `MVHEVCS_I_Nokia_3`

VPS groups layers as `[0, 3]`, `[1, 4]`, and `[2, 5]`; all layers use 1024x768,
8-bit 4:2:0 samples over nine pictures. Display-order YUV MD5 values are

`f20e9e1cf6638bd66c09e4e3715b1040` (layer 1),

`349a6c09fdcb7269e36f059e41b90729` (layer 3),
`6fd79629683c4e1c5f5474481bb15f56` (layer 4), and
`ef6f199c9790b568705ec46be5ab0c62` (layer 5). The bitstream SHA-256 is
`daa8857e6cb34ca3f56554b0fcd12eb939a3e484156e25982c5e5c22cd71ba14`.

SVA_Base_B-first.264 and SVA_Base_B-first.yuv: the first IDR access unit and
first reconstructed picture from the official ITU-T H.264.1 `SVA_Base_B`
Baseline conformance archive. The archive CRC32 is `E0F7F0F7`; its README
specifies QCIF 176x144, 17 frames, an IDR first frame and three slices per
picture. FFmpeg 9.0.1 stream-copied the first frame to the 1,952-byte Annex-B
fixture (SHA-256
`f96dbec5a43c2448fee8ff560b3232f3845b9b69021a3e398339f1c78e4d0a46`). The
YUV fixture is the first 38,016 bytes of the archive reconstruction file
(SHA-256 `739b74d45185b3de416f702794fd502eea98bbeb247a9cb05d0ce8be1298de89`).
`test/avcc.test.ts` compares all I420 samples, wraps the frame as `avc1`, then
places two copies in a synthetic in-file AVC `tili` image and compares the
rendered rows with the repeated source image.
Official specification and test-signal sources:
https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-H.264.1/en
https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jvt-site/draft_conformance/AVCv1/SVA_Base_B.zip
